limits: Temporary homes and synthetic content; the terms record is synthetic (OD-1 deferred). SC-009's paths outside the plugin home or the given directory is read as: the output must be a canonical path without symbolic links or traversal inside an existing directory; the output is not restricted to the plugin home (the owner chooses where datasets go). --level is required as REQ-009 writes it; the profile's export.level is not used as a default. The socket and process guard covers this process only; the static import check covers Lightning module imports.
outcome: passed: T009: agent-braid lightning export (--run ... | --all) --kind --level --out [--seed] [--balance] [--outcome-field] [--terms-decision] [--dry-run] refuses with export-disabled unless the profile has export.enabled true: with consent but export never enabled, with export disabled, with no profile and with an unparseable one. With export enabled it exports and prints one JSON object of exactly the fixed fields (counts, exclusions, balance report, terms decision citation, redaction version, records and manifest hashes, files, executionAuthorization false) whose hashes match the written manifest, never the record entries, a rollout id, an attempt pseudonym, a raw id, the content or a path; --all, supervised with the outcome field, balance none and a seed work. --dry-run builds the same manifest (same digest as a real export) and writes nothing, and applies the output checks. Output refusals: an existing non-empty directory and a file (output-not-empty), a symlink, a symlinked parent, a missing parent and paths with .. (path-refused); nothing is written and the symlink target stays empty. Invalid arguments refuse with invalid-argument (balanced supervised, outcome field on rollout, negative seed, a run named twice) or through the argument parser (unknown kind, level, balance, no source). A missing run refuses with store-missing and consent none with no-records. Host-run units refuse with terms-gate-missing without and with a missing record, and the terms directory is never created; with a SYNTHETIC permitting record in a temporary home they export, the output cites the record path, prints none of its contents, and the record and directory are unchanged. Every refusal is one stderr line with a fixed code and text naming no path, raw id, content or provider, and an unexpected OSError or ValueError prints code other and a fixed text. Under patched socket, create_connection, subprocess.Popen and os.system the export succeeds; the Lightning import boundary (tests.test_lightning_cli) now covers lightning_export. Negative controls (mutants, each fails a test): export.enabled ignored, an invalid profile not treated as disabled, raw exception text printed, the code not checked, executionAuthorization changed, record entries printed, a dry run that writes, the early output check removed, the canonical-path check removed and the terms flag dropped.
